reason: E1 and E2 confirm Cr/V precipitation in the baseline alloy, but neither provides evidence that Hf retards Cr/V diffusion, suppresses precipitation, improves processability, or maintains negligible hardening in this system.
premises: Undoped W38Ta36Cr15V11 develops Cr/V-rich precipitates under irradiation to ~8 dpa at 1073 K
Hf has low diffusivity and larger atomic size that can slow Cr/V diffusion
Slowing Cr/V diffusion will suppress precipitate nucleation and growth
Hf addition will improve bulk fabrication processability
Hf addition will not increase irradiation hardening
